title: Revisiting the Gold Standard: Grounding Summarization Evaluation with Robust Human Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the correlation between summary lengths and human evaluation scores across different annotation protocols to demonstrate that unconstrained human annotators inherently favor longer summaries.

Comparing human evaluation scores from input-agnostic (Prior) protocols with reference-free and reference-based protocols to measure how much annotators' subjective, prior preferences for certain generation styles (e.g., zero-shot outputs from GPT-3) skew objective evaluation.
